summary: +2 to attack and damage rolls, 2d8 Necrotic on a hit; once a day it casts Spirit Lantern (DC 17) holding five fragments.
text: You have a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this sickle, and a hit with it deals an extra 2d8 Necrotic damage. While holding it you can cast Spirit Lantern (save DC 17) from it once per dawn; that lantern can hold up to five spirit fragments.
